title: FLAC files written by Syrp decode to the same samples and metadata

docs.says: Reads and writes the lossless-compression FLAC audio format.

notes: The inputs are produced by Syrp's writer from the ramp signal (tests/scenarios.rs in syrp-format-flac regenerates and checks them): mono 16-bit 44.1 kHz 3,000 frames at quality 5; stereo 24-bit 48 kHz 2,000 frames at quality 8 with TITLE=Ramp and ARTIST=Syrp; six channels 16-bit 96 kHz 1,200 frames at quality 0.
